title: My Weekend
subtitle: 考点：at weekends / 家务 / 一般现在时
passage: At weekends, I do not get up early. At nine o'clock, I do some housework with Mom. We clean the rooms and wash clothes. In the afternoon, I play basketball outside with my friends.
In the evening, I finish my homework and prepare my school things for Monday. Weekends are short, but I enjoy them.
vocab: weekend 周末 · at weekends 在周末 · housework 家务劳动 · outside 在外面 · prepare 准备 · finish 完成 · only 只
